svg.aria-label: LPJ-EOSIM model ecosystem: lpj_download driver data, the LPJ-EOSIM model source, the pipeline Python API and lpj-eosim-run-scripts feed production runs on SLURM or AWS and debug runs locally. lpj_download releases drivers to a Zenodo archive for reproducibility, and the pipeline can ingest them from there. Production runs publish provenance and artifacts to lpj-registry on Wasabi, whose web UI compares any run against every past run, and feed TRENDY, a near-real-time carbon budget, the Global Methane Budget, WIEMIP, NMIP, NASA LP DAAC (daily pushes with a 4-month latency) and subseasonal-to-seasonal forecasting of carbon fluxes. A run-lpj Claude Code skill can run all three GitHub repos. Three revise loops return to the code: local debugging, the pull-request global regression test against the known-good output, and MIP feedback and yearly cycles.
svg.title: LPJ-EOSIM model ecosystem

g.text: • Web UI: compare vs every past run
MIP feedback & yearly cycles: revise & rerun
Global regression test vs KGO: revise & re-push
